# Enhanced Console

> Unity Editor console window for Unity 6 that runs beside Unity's Console: section-based log filtering by name or regex, search across messages and stack traces, collapse modes, log timestamps (time since startup, wall clock or frame), error pause, autoscroll, search highlighting, logs from background threads, compiler errors kept after Clear, clickable stack traces, keyboard navigation, deleting selected logs, multi-select and copying logs with or without stack traces. Editor-only, no dependencies, no logging API required. MIT licensed, pre-release (0.x), single author, no other users yet.
